title: 15.51. Upādinnaduka, Kusalattika
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Anupādinnaṁ kusalaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca naupādinno nakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṁ …pe… avigate ekaṁ.
Anupādinnaṁ akusalaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca naupādinno naakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṁ …pe… avigate ekaṁ. (Abyākatamūlaṁ ekaṁyeva paccayavasena.)
